evidence: ImageNet is an image database organized by the WordNet hierarchy. Paper 721 invokes it only as an analogy for benchmark libraries; it is not training/evaluation data for that review.
Gym is software/API plus reference reinforcement-learning environments, not a static dataset. Paper 721 cites it as an analogy for benchmark infrastructure.

Zenodo describes endocardial/epicardial left and right atrial surfaces for seven anatomies, fibre fields, average fibre fields, universal atrial coordinates and CARP-compatible mesh files. Paper 835 uses the public atlas as benchmark ground truth.
